notes: Ludum Dare 45 Compo (https://ldjam.com/events/ludum-dare/45/hello-buddy; https://d4rkweasel.itch.io/hello-buddy) by Alexander Erlemann (TheDarkWeasel). Complete Unity 2019.3.7f1 project with playable Title and Level scenes in EditorBuildSettings (collect friendly green atoms, avoid hostile red atoms, grow and evolve). MIT at repo-root LICENSE (Copyright 2019 Alexander Erlemann). Author states everything here, including music, sounds, and assets, was created by them in 48 hours. Official Unity packages only (TextMesh Pro 2.0.1, Timeline, uGUI, and built-in modules); no TMP assets or fonts are bundled in the repo. Omitted Unity Logs/. No DOTween, no EmojiOne, no FXAA, no Unity Standard Assets, no Asset Store packages, no LFS, no DLL. ~3.2M src snapshot.
